scope: ARM advisory only; no web server, no FPGA register access, no overlay loading

transport.format: UTF-8 JSONL; one complete JSON object per newline
transport.output: one JSON state per second on stdout
transport.external_default: tail new records only; no simulated fallback
transport.from_start: opt-in replay; producer must report accurate age_seconds
transport.restart: source_restart resets sequence tracking and diagnostic history

input_fields.sequence: required nonnegative integer, strictly increasing per transport packet
input_fields.channels: object with hr, spo2, body, room; absent channels are unavailable
input_fields.channels.*.sequence: required observation counter; increments for each new communication/quality report
input_fields.channels.*.sample_sequence: required for valid values; increments only on a real new measurement, not polling or retransmission
input_fields.channels.*.value: finite physical-unit number when valid, otherwise null
input_fields.channels.*.age_seconds: measurement age at ingestion, default 0 for immediate live input; must include buffering/replay delay
input_fields.channels.*.quality_known: Boolean; false when upstream quality is unavailable
input_fields.channels.*.raw_quality_known: Boolean, false for KPT_D01 numeric-only frames
input_fields.channels.*.rail_ratio: 0..1, required only with actual raw waveform evidence
input_fields.channels.*.valid_periods: nonnegative integer, required only with actual raw waveform evidence
input_fields.danger_active: optional Boolean independent upstream FPGA danger flag
input_fields.source_label: optional display label; does not certify physical measurement

output_fields.fpga_state: original upstream four-state value, unchanged; null if not supplied or expired
output_fields.assessment_valid: original permitted channel combinations available and no upstream SystemError
output_fields.danger_active: ARM alarm or fresh upstream danger; never masked by data insufficiency
output_fields.evidence: code, observed, decision, next_step, channels, priority
output_fields.channels.*.last_valid_age: seconds since last credible measurement, null if none

original_fpga_rules.permitted_combinations: all four, any three, or exactly spo2+body

parameters: settings.json affects ARM advisory only; reload on process restart, no FPGA writes
threshold_status: student demonstration parameters, not a clinically validated diagnostic algorithm
help_delivery: local SQLite event only; no remote receiver integration in this headless release

storage.csv: UTF-8 BOM; invalid measurements empty, source_mode present
